text:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — we need month-level clarity for the Lighthouse initiative so PMs and partners can book release windows.

sanjay: brief update: targeting a staggered rollout in Q3/Q4. i can call out target months and which are commitments vs targets.

julia: to be explicit on scope: API = runtime latency knobs + fallback routing, Console = traffic-shaping UI + rollout controls, Optimize = cost recs + evaluation harness. no other scope added, right?

maria: correct. also ask: how long should Dedicated reserve capacity for the canary? ops needs that number.

anna: rough timeline (subject to kernel patch): API beta -> Aug (target), Console beta -> Sep, Optimize v1 -> Oct, Dedicated canary -> Nov 1 (planned).

sanjay: commitment: canary start = Nov 1. other months are targets; if kernel patch slips, add a 4-week contingency.

julia: SDK warning: streaming SDK changes land early Aug; SDK team requests a 3-week freeze for integration testing after that.

maria: noted — please avoid API contract changes during the freeze.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: lighthouse-roadmap-summary -> /eng-docs/lighthouse/summary (created by anna)

anna: action item: i'll publish a one-pager with gating metrics, fallback offsets, and the canary-length (default 2 weeks) by EOW. tagging @cs for canary participant nominations. :thumbsup:
